Public list of plans, billing periods and prices. No key is needed. The example values are illustrative. Live names and prices come from this endpoint.

amodb is a paid API for movie and TV metadata. It is compatible with TMDB v3 and OMDb.

Existing TMDB clients work by changing the base URL to `https://api.amodb.dev/3`. Paths, query parameters and JSON shapes match the TMDB v3 read endpoints that amodb offers. A few TMDB routes are not offered, see Routes that are not offered below.

## Access

amodb is a paid API. Get a key at https://amodb.dev/pricing. A key is 32 lowercase hex characters.

- TMDB style routes: send `Authorization: Bearer KEY` or add `?api_key=KEY`.
- OMDb route: add `apikey=KEY`.
- Images and plans need no key.

## Rate limits

Plans differ only in requests per minute. Every plan gets all data. There is no free tier and no trial.

| Plan id | Requests per minute |
|---|---|
| lite | 20 |
| pro | 40 |
| proplus | 120 |

Every keyed response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (seconds). A 429 adds `Retry-After`. Live plan names and prices come from `GET /plans`.

## Languages

`language` accepts TMDB tags such as `ru-RU` or `pt-BR`. Fourteen base languages are served: en, ru, uk, be, zh, pt, bg, he, cs, ro, fr, pl, it, es. A bare code works, the legacy code iw maps to he, and any other value falls back to en. Only some endpoints read `language`. Each operation lists the parameters it really uses.

## Lists and paging

`page` runs from 1 to 500. Lists and search return 20 items per page.

## Errors

TMDB style routes return `{"success": false, "status_code": N, "status_message": "..."}`. The codes are 7 and 10 (key), 11 (internal), 22 (bad parameters, HTTP 400), 24 (timeout), 25 (rate limit), 34 (not found, HTTP 404), 36 (plan expired) and 37 (not offered, HTTP 405). The OMDb route returns `{"Response": "False", "Error": "..."}`, usually with HTTP 200.

## Routes that are not offered

These TMDB routes answer 405 with status_code 37 and the message "This method is not offered by amodb.": everything under `account`, `authentication`, `guest_session` and `list`, and any path that ends in `/account_states` or `/rating`. Write methods never work.

These TMDB routes answer 404 with status_code 34, as does any other unknown path:

- `aggregate_credits` of movies, shows and seasons
- `changes` of movies, shows and people
- `/person/{id}/translations`, `/person/latest` and `/person/{id}/tagged_images`
- `/credit/{credit_id}`, `/review/{review_id}` and `/tv/episode_group/{id}`
- `images`, `translations` and `alternative_names` of collections, companies and networks
- `/tv/{id}/screened_theatrically` and `/configuration/timezones`
- `content_ratings` of a movie and `release_dates` of a TV show

`append_to_response` silently ignores a name it does not know, so `aggregate_credits` and `changes` have no effect there. `include_adult` is ignored because adult titles and people are never served and answer 404.

## Data limits

- Reviews are loaded on demand. Many titles have none, and the list is then empty.
- Season `images`, `videos` and `translations` are empty. Season and episode `external_ids` are all null.
- TV show details have no `type` field, and `created_by` is empty for most shows.
- Company `description` is empty and `parent_company` is null.

## Images

`GET /3/configuration` returns `images.secure_base_url`, which is `https://img.amodb.dev/t/p/`. Append a size and a `file_path` to build an image URL.

## Extensions

amodb adds `moods`, `soundtracks`, `ratings`, `wikidata` and `showtimes` for movies and TV shows. Each has its own route and an `append_to_response` value. Appended `moods`, `soundtracks` and `ratings` have no `id`. Appended `wikidata` and `showtimes` keep it. `/3/find/{external_id}` also accepts `kinopoisk_id`, and `external_ids` of movies and shows carry `kinopoisk_id` when it is known.

## Caching

Responses carry `Cache-Control`. Details, credits and sub resources are cached for 6 hours, showtimes for 30 minutes, lists, trending and discover for 30 minutes, search for 10 minutes, configuration, genres and provider lists for 24 hours, and the latest movie for 10 minutes.
